BCC on_page
    INC v_ptr + 1
    CLC                             \ carry clear to return
.on_page
    LDA &C0
    STA (v_ptr)                     \ 65C02 opcode
    LDY #1
    LDA &C1
    STA (v_ptr),Y
    RTS                             \ carry clear: drawn
.in_hazel
    JSR compiled_direct
    BCC called

    LDA &C0
    STA b_ptr
    LDA &C1
    STA b_ptr + 1
    LDA ds_n
    STA ds_c
    SEC

}

candidates.new:
BCS cp2_page_cross              \ the rare carry: off the hot path, which falls through
.on_page
    LDA &C0
    STA (v_ptr)                     \ 65C02 opcode
    LDY #1
    LDA &C1
    STA (v_ptr),Y
    RTS                             \ carry clear: drawn
.cp2_page_cross                     \ v_ptr + 11 crossed a page (rare)
    INC v_ptr + 1
    CLC                             \ carry clear to return
    BRA on_page                     \ 65C02 opcode
.in_hazel
    JSR compiled_direct
    BCC called
.unsafe                             \ the code's row pointers used b_ptr and ds_c
    LDA &C0                         \ (C = 1 here from either path: BCS unsafe, BCC called not taken)
    STA b_ptr
    LDA &C1
    STA b_ptr + 1
    LDA ds_n
    STA ds_c
    RTS
}
candidates.summary: compiled_part's tail: the rare page carry (v_ptr + 11) goes out of line (BCS to a stub that does INC/CLC/BRA back) so the hot path falls through 1 cycle cheaper (2.2 a pass); drops the SEC before unsafe's RTS (C is already 1 on both entries); deletes the unreferenced up_a_cell (16 bytes). Alternative to the other candidate (same lines).
candidates.equivalence: Hot path: after ADC #11 the carry is the page carry; the old BCC on_page taken (3 cycles) becomes BCS not taken (2) falling into on_page with C=0, same A/Y/flags (nothing between reads A). Rare path: BCS taken to the stub, INC v_ptr + 1, CLC, BRA on_page: the old INC;CLC;fallthrough with the same registers (INC and CLC only touch v_ptr+1 and C). on_page's tail is unchanged and is reached only from these two places (local label, grep). unsafe: the SEC is redundant because every entry has C=1 (BCS unsafe taken; BCC called not taken after compiled_direct; LDA/STA leave C); the dataflow annotation shows C=1 at the LDA &C0. up_a_cell has no caller or reference anywhere in src/ (grep), no entry past it (no up_a_cell + n), and it sits between compiled_part's closing brace and raise_address, whose own in_ring label is inside its own scope.
candidates.relies_on: Measured 2026-10-22 on the bench build: render+logic+interrupts a pass 3 cycles lower than HEAD on seed 1 (1500 passes) and 3 lower holding RIGHT (600 passes from 50), render 23430 -> 23427 and 28406 -> 28403. Net -15 bytes: raise_address moves from &9D49 to &9D3A and everything after in bank 4 by -15; the page crossings it moves were measured as part of that figure (raise_cells_lo/hi stay in one page, restore_block &9D8C). Measured 2026-10-22 on a scratch copy of HEAD (bench build, DEBUG_LIVES, tools/pcprof.mjs --unclobber --detail): work a pass render+logic+interrupts. No other label refers to the removed up_a_cell (grep src/ tools/ docs/: only name lists filtered by symbol existence in passcost.mjs and pccats.py). unsafe is entered only by BCS unsafe (C=1) and BCC called not taken (C=1), and compiled_unsafe_N / the kinds' SEC;RTS return with C=1 through compiled_call's carry-neutral LDA/STA.
